ApiError.description: An API error: a stable code and a message for the technician's screen.

level.description: A level of the pack; the first when absent.

support.description: The deterministic gate's view of the question (all modes).

tool.description:
The deterministic tool that answered first, if any
(`range_table:<section_id>`).

pack_id.description: The pack whose equipment ids are checked.

AssetEventInput.description: A past maintenance event from the fleet registry.

AssetHistory.description:
An asset's history: its own jobs and registry events, the pack's fleet
history and failure modes for its variant, and the repeat flag.

repeat.description: True when the newest job repeats an earlier one within the window.

AssetInput.description: A physical unit, as entered or imported.

asset_id.description: The fleet's own id (unit number). Generated when absent.

AssetRegistry.description: An asset registry file (`harvest-assets/1`), to preload a fleet.

changes.description: Fields given replace the stored ones; `attrs` merge.

AttachReport.description: What one pass of the attachment lane did.

backlog_bytes.description: Bytes still to send under the current policy.

completed.description: Variants the hub now holds in full (sent now or found there).

damaged.description:
Attachments whose stored copy is damaged on this device (set aside;
the record keeps its reference).

resumed.description:
Variants continued from where the hub had them, and the bytes not
resent because of it.

yielded.description: Stopped early because the host asked (records waiting, window closing).

AttachmentMode.description: What attachments travel on a link (the hub's policy per link class).

oneOf.description: Only the references (they travel with the records); the files wait.
The downscaled copy when the host made one, else the file.

AttachmentStatus.description: The attachment lane's state, apart from the records'.

damaged.description: Files whose stored copy is damaged on this device.

last_attempt_at.description: The last pass, and its error when it failed.

mode.description:
The hub's policy for this device's link at the last hello (`None`
before any).

pending.description: Files still to send under that policy (under `full` when unknown).

sent.description: Files the hub holds in full, and those it holds only downscaled.

AuditChunk.description: One retrieved chunk as the log keeps it.

AuditEvent.description:
One recorded action that is not a question: a troubleshooting job's
start, answer, correction and close, a lesson, a field-note install.
It chains like an answer entry.

asked.description: What was asked there: the node's verbatim text.

next_node.description: Where code sent the job next.

node_id.description: The node the job was at.

subject.description: What the event is about (a job id, a lesson id, a bundle stream).

after_seq.description: Only entries after this sequence number.

AuditRecord.description: One row of the log, as read back.

git_hash.description: The flight software's custom version (a git hash, as autopilots send it).

Basis.description: What a deficiency rests on (CONTRACT "Procedure step deficiency").

oneOf.description: A rule: `section_id` and a verbatim `quote` say so.

Field practice with no rule behind it: no citation, and never shown
as a rule.

voltage.description: Volts, the sum of the cells reported.

Branch.description: A branch the technician can take, as code will take it.

outcome.description:
The outcome to send for a categorical branch (`yes`, `fail`, an
option, `done`); `None` for a measured value.

Candidate.description: A variant the observation points at.

contradicted.description: Rules of this variant the observation contradicts (a rejected one).

first_bad.description: The first sequence number whose hash or link is wrong.

head_hash.description:
The hash of the newest entry. The chain detects edits but cannot see
its own newest rows removed: a host that needs that anchors
`(entries, head_hash)` outside the database (an upload, a signature).

modes.description: Answers per mode (`sealed` counts entries read without the key).

cites_ok.description: Every cite in the input named an existing section.

dropped.description: Segments removed (bad quotes, bad cites, unsupported claims).

quotes_ok.description: Every quote in the input was verbatim and named an existing section.

section_id.description: The parent; the manual's top level when absent.

Citation.description:
A citation down to the page: manual, edition, the section path
(chapter, paragraph …), page and figure.

boxes.description: Where the passage sits on that page image, normalized 0 to 1.

page_asset_id.description: The page image to open (a signed asset), when the pack has one.

path.description: Root first, ending with this section.

CitePart.description: One level of a citation path.

Closest.description: The closest entries for one text observation no rule matched.

query.description:
The words searched: the text with a leading tag (`PreArm:`) taken
off and numbers and instance digits dropped.

signals.description: Text rules of the same signal kind, rated by the same rule.

symptoms.description: The symptom index, ranked and rated as `symptom.search` does.

ClosestSignal.description: A signal rule close to an unmatched text.

margin.description: The score's lead over the best other rule (its own score alone).

Cond.description:
A numeric predicate over a measured value (`fault_edge.cond`):
`{"op":"<","value":11.5}` or `{"op":"between","min":11.5,"max":13}`.

max_inclusive.description: `between` only: is `max` in the range (default false)?

min_inclusive.description: `between` only: is `min` in the range (default true)?

oneOf.description:
`min <= v < max` by default; `min_inclusive` / `max_inclusive`
say otherwise (a printed "0.6 TO 1.2" is both inclusive).

Confidence.description:
How sure a symptom match is, by a fixed rule (CONTRACT "Symptom
search"): `confident` when a signal matched, when the query's
meaningful words are covered (at least `symptom_confident_coverage` of
them, and at least two or all of them), or when the dense cosine
reaches `symptom_confident_dense` beside a lexical match; `closest`
otherwise; `none` for a search with no hit.

Conflict.description: A conflict between two units' versions of a lesson and how it resolved.

class.description:
`auto` (the rule decided) or `needs_reviewer` (the edits were within
the clock-skew bound; a reviewer chooses the version).

resolved_by.description: The reviewer who chose, for a `needs_reviewer` conflict.

dm1.description: J1939 DM1 messages, one per source address and message.

errors.description:
Input lines or frames that could not be read, and why (decoding
goes on past them).

mavlink.description: MAVLink messages, when the input was MAVLink.

DenseOff.description: Why dense search is off for a pack.

oneOf.description: The pack was baked without vectors.
The host loaded no embedder for this pack.
The host's embedder is not the one the pack was baked with.

DenseStatus.description: Whether dense search runs for a pack on this host.

DenseStatus2.description: Why the dense half did or did not run.

oneOf.description: Vectors compared.
No embedder supplied: lexical only.

The embedder's id/dim differ from the pack's `embedder_id`/`embed_dim`.
Dense retrieval is refused rather than comparing incompatible vectors.
The pack carries no vectors.

DeviceInfo.description: This device as the hub knows it.

device_id.description: `dev-<key id>`; `None` when no hub link (and so no device key) is set.

public_key.description: The base64 ed25519 public key an administrator enrolls.

Dm1.description: A DM1 message from one source.

dtcs.description: Empty when the source reports no active codes.

conversion_method.description:
The SPN conversion method bit (1: an older byte order; read as
sent, flagged so the host can tell).

active.description: False when the code is previously active.

code.description: A PID (`sid` false) or a SID (`sid` true) of the transmitter.

EnrolledDevice.description: A device the hub accepts uploads from (or no longer does).

oneOf.description: From a reported symptom (typed, spoken or picked from a search).
From signals read from the machine.
The technician chose the tree.

node_id.description: The node to start at (the tree's entry when the rule names none).

EquipView.description: A variant with its inherited attributes.

Expect.description: How a result is recorded at a node (`fault_node.expect`).

oneOf.description: Outcome `yes` or `no`; edges labelled Yes and No.
Outcome `pass` or `fail`; edges labelled Pass and Fail.
Outcome is one of `options`; one edge labelled with each.

A measured value in `unit`; edges carry numeric conditions that
partition `[min, max]` (the whole line when absent). `labels` are
readings the manual names instead of a number ("NO INDICATION"):
each has one plain branch with that label, chosen by its outcome.
Outcome `done`; one edge.

Facet.description:
One verbatim facet text of a node (`reason`, `known`, `possible`,
`test_option`, …: the pack names them; the core treats them as opaque).

FacetDef.description:
A facet the pack names: its id and the manual's heading for it
(`pack_meta.facets`, an ordered list; the order is the display order).

FacetGroup.description:
A node's facet (`reason`, `known`, `possible`, `test_option`, …), in
order, and whether the level opens it.

label.description:
The manual's own heading for it (`pack_meta.facets`); `None` when
the pack names none (validation reports that).

FailureMode.description: How a variant fails across the fleet.

FaultEdge.description: One branch out of a node, chosen by code from the recorded result.

cond.description: A numeric predicate; `None` matches by label equality.

retry.description: An explicit loop back (re-test after an adjustment).

FaultNode.description: One node of a tree. `text` is the manual's own words.

proc_id.description: The procedure whose steps tell how to answer this node's question.

reference.description:
The manual's printed cross-reference ("Refer to field maintenance"),
verbatim; kept also when it resolves to no target in the pack.

applies_to.description: Equipment the tree is limited to (empty: all).

FieldNote.description: A field note as stored and shown: field knowledge, never manual text.

pack_id.description:
The pack the note was issued for (its tree and node ids are that
pack's); any pack when `None`.

source.description: Always `field`: the host shows it apart from the manual.

FieldNoteIn.description: A reviewer-approved field note as the hub sends it.

FleetSummary.description: What the fleet shows, aggregated by the hub across every unit.

actions.description: Corrective actions: how often each resolved the fault it was tried on.

jobs.description: Jobs per symptom (or tree, when entered without one) and variant.

repeats.description: The same asset with the same symptom or system again within the window.

top_causes.description: The most frequent verified causes per symptom.

error.description: The transport's error, when a batch failed.

rejected_receipts.description: Receipts that named no item of the batch or the wrong hash.

Fold.description: Whether a test procedure opens expanded or collapsed at a level.

oneOf.description: candump log lines (`(t) can0 18FECA00#…` or `can0 18FECA00 [8] …`).
One frame per line: `<29-bit id hex> <data hex>` (`18FECA00 0400D20A12000000`).

J1708 messages as hex bytes, one per line (MID first; a trailing
checksum byte is checked when present).
A display code typed by hand (`E21-3`, `21.3`, `21 / 3`).
A MAVLink `.tlog` file, base64.
Raw MAVLink bytes (a capture of the link), base64.

Fusion.description: How lexical and dense scores combine.

oneOf.description: `w * lexical + (1 - w) * cosine` with dense active, else `lexical`.

Reciprocal-rank fusion: `1 / (rrf_k + rank)` summed over the lexical
and the dense ranking (kept for comparison; not the default).

Guard.description: A warning, caution or note, verbatim.

Guidance.description: What to do when a step fails, and the rule behind it when there is one.

basis.description:
`rule` or `practice`. A pack row without it is a rule when it cites a
section and practice when it does not; the reader always fills it in.

HelloReply.description: The hub's answer to a hello.

attachments.description: What attachments may travel on the link the device named.

device_id.description: The device the hub answered (signed with the rest).

fleet_every_hours.description:
How often a device fetches a changed fleet summary (a hub setting
the device learns here).

hello_sha256.description:
The SHA-256 of the signed hello this answers (its canonical JSON,
signature included) and the link class it named: a reply to any
other hello counts for nothing.

signature.description: The hub's signature over the rest (its bundle key).

stream.description: The hub's bundle stream: a device pulls by this stream's seq.

HistoryEvent.description: A fleet history event baked in the pack.

HistoryJob.description: A job in an asset's history, with its own repeat flag.

tree_title.description: The tree's title in the pack (when the pack is at hand).

Hit.description:
One retrieved chunk. `lexical` is the BM25 score (higher is better, 0 when
the lexical list missed it), `dense` the cosine (0 when not compared),
`score` the fused (or reranked) score the list is sorted by.

edit.description: Edit before approving: the note's text and/or scope.

version.description:
The version to approve (an item id from the queue); required when
the lesson `needs_reviewer`.

limit.description: At most this many (default 50, at most 200), in seq order.

public_key.description: The device's ed25519 public key, base64.

HubFlush.description: What one upload attempt through a hub did.

flush.description: What was sent; `None` unless the hub accepted the device.

hello.description:
The hub's answer to the hello; `None` when the attempt was skipped
(backing off) or the link failed before an answer.

skipped_until.description: Skipped: backing off after a refusal until this time.

limit.description: At most this many (default 500, at most 5000).

since.description: Statements after this hub sequence (`next_since` of the last page).

always.description: Publish a bundle (with the fleet summary) even when no note changed.

limit.description: At most this many (default 100, at most 500).

HubState.description:
Where the upload destination stands: configured, and reachable as of
the last attempt (never probed live).

backoff_until.description: No upload is tried before this time (backing off after a refusal).

destination.description: `folder` (a removable drive or shared folder) or `hub`.

reachable.description:
Whether the hub answered on the last attempt (a refusal is an
answer); `None` before any. Never probed live.

refused.description:
Why the hub refused this device: `unenrolled`, `revoked` or
`signature`; `None` when accepted or not yet asked.

Job.description: One troubleshooting session on an asset.

steps.description: Every recorded step, superseded ones included, in order.

JobAnswerParams.description: Record the result at the job's current node.

node_id.description: The node answered: must be the job's current node.

level.description: Show the step at another level than the job's.

tree_known.description: False when the tree changed since the job began (node texts absent).

superseded_at.description: When the technician went back over it (the step is kept, audited).

tree_id.description: The tree the node belongs to (a job can follow a goto into another).

tree_title.description: The tree's title in the pack (when the pack is at hand).

JobView.description: A job and the screen for its current node.

step.description: `None` when the tree changed since the job began (`tree_changed`).

LessonInput.description: What fixed it, in the technician's words.

job_id.description: Fills asset, equipment, tree, symptom and node when they are absent.

lesson_id.description:
The lesson's id when it continues one begun on another unit (its
edits then meet at the hub); new when absent.

submit.description: Queue it for upload now (default) or keep it on the device.

LessonVersion.description: One stored version of a lesson.

state.description:
`current` (the winner), `superseded` (an earlier version from the
winner's unit) or `lost` (another unit's version that lost the rule).

Level.description: A depth level, from `pack_meta.levels` (ordered, most guidance first).

facets.description:
Facets shown expanded at this level; `None`: all of them. Warnings,
cautions and notes are not facets and are shown at every level.

test_steps.description: How a node's test procedure opens.

LevelText.description: Baked detail text for a level (the section's explanation).

LinkClass.description:
How good the device's current link is (the host decides: a satellite
or radio link is `low`).

ManualHit.description: One search hit with its text and citation.

search.description: The engine's search result (scores, dense status, readings).

oneOf.description:
The model judged the question truly ambiguous; `body` holds one
clarifying question (a text segment) and `nearest` the sections it
might be about.
The reported symptom, where a tree usually begins.
A question the technician answers by a test or an observation.
Something to do (replace, adjust, repair).
Continue in another tree or a procedure.
Beyond this level of maintenance: hand it up.
The tree ends here.

scope.description: Where it shows; the lesson's variant, tree and symptom when absent.

text.description: The field note's text; from the lesson when absent.

NoteScope.description: What a field note is about: any of these; every one given must match.

NoteScopeInput.description: What a field note is about: any of these; every one given must match.

Observation.description:
A normalized machine observation (protocol decoding happens before
this): `{"signal_kind": "j1939.dm1", "value": "spn:110/fmi:0"}`,
`{"signal_kind": "obd2.dtc", "value": "P0217"}`. A `null` kind (a code
typed off a display) is matched against every kind.

ObservationInput.description:
A normalized machine observation (protocol decoding happens before
this): `{"signal_kind": "j1939.dm1", "value": "spn:110/fmi:0"}`,
`{"signal_kind": "obd2.dtc", "value": "P0217"}`. A `null` kind (a code
typed off a display) is matched against every kind.

oneOf.description: Not applicable to this machine or job.

PackAsset.description: A file of the signed pack (a figure crop or a page image).

path.description: Relative to the pack directory, listed in the signed manifest.

PackInfoView.description: What a pack is and how to talk to it.

dense.description: Whether dense search runs for this pack on this host, and why not.

facets.description: Facet headings, in the manual's order.

signal_kinds.description: The signal kinds the pack maps, with a label and an example.

PackParams.description: Which pack (the only one loaded when absent).

PackSummary.description: One installed pack, for choosing among several.

dense.description: Whether dense search runs for this pack on this host, and why not.

equipment_roots.description: The top of each equipment tree (no parent).

title.description: `pack_meta.title`, else the first source's title, else the id.

PackUpdate.description: A pack replaced by a newer one from the hub.

PageBox.description:
A box on a page image, normalized 0 to 1 against the image: `x0 < x1`,
`y0 < y1`, origin top left.

PageParams.description:
A page of a hub list: skip `offset`, return at most `limit` (default
100, at most 500). Fewer than `limit` means the end.

PathEntry.description: One answered step on the path, for the screen.

PhotoRef.description: A photo the host stored; the record keeps its path and hash.

Plate.description: What the technician or the machine reports.

text.description: Free text (a data plate read aloud or by a camera).

next_since.description: Pass as `since` for the next page.

statements.description:
xAPI-style statements (actor, verb, object, result, context,
timestamp, stored).

equip_id.description: The variant (questions that do not apply to it are left out).

answer.description: mc: the choice index as text; numeric: the value; free_text: rubric JSON.

rationale_citations.description:
One per rationale: where the manual says it. The answer's comes from
the question's own section; a wrong choice's from the section that
holds the passage its rationale quotes (or the choice itself), when
one does; `null` otherwise.

rationales.description: One per choice: why right, why wrong.

at.description: When it was answered (RFC 3339); now when absent.

chosen.description:
The choice index as text (mc), the value (numeric) or the text
written (free_text).

ms.description: Milliseconds from showing the question to the answer.

via.description: How they were identified: `token`, `proxy` or `local` (in process).

PullReport.description: What one pull from the hub did.

fleet_bytes.description: Bytes of the fleet summary received (fetched only when it changed).

refused.description:
The bundle that was refused (and why); the pull stops there and the
next one asks for it again.

Ranking.description:
The symptom ranking and confidence rule (CONTRACT "Symptom search"):
the code defaults, then `pack_meta`, then a caller's overrides. A
search returns the values it applied and whether dense was active, so
any result can be replayed.

dense_active.description: Whether the dense half ran for this result (set by the search).

dense_floor.description:
`symptom_dense_floor`: a dense hit with no lexical match is listed
from this cosine.

weak_words.description: The weak words in force (the core list or the pack's, plus additions).

RankingParams.description: Overrides of a pack's ranking, field by field.

Reading.description: How a query word the pack does not hold as typed was read.

as.description: The indexed words it was read as.

RecordHow.description: How to record the result here. `expect` is `None` at the end of a path.

Refusal.description: Why the hub refuses a device.

oneOf.description: The hub does not know this device's key.
An administrator revoked it.
The signature does not verify against the enrolled key.

RegistryAsset.description: One entry of an asset registry.

RepeatFlag.description:
Repeat discrepancy: the same asset with the same symptom or system again
within the pack's window.

RepeatMatch.description: Why a job (or event) counts toward a repeat discrepancy.

ReportJobStep.description: One step of a job report.

superseded_at.description: When the technician went back over it (the step is kept, audited).

tree_id.description: The tree the node belongs to (a job can follow a goto into another).

ReportStep.description:
One step of a report: the pack's step (when known) and what was recorded
(`outcome` is null when the step was not recorded).

Requirement.description: What a task, tree or node needs.

ident.description: Part number, tool number or document number.

verbatim.description: True when `text` is verbatim in `section_id`'s text.

node_id.description: The node the job ended at.

oneOf.description: The fault is corrected.
Handed to a higher level of maintenance.
Continued in another tree or task.
Stopped without a fix.

ambiguous.description: True when more than one unrelated variant fits.

attrs.description: Attributes of `equip_id`, inherited from its ancestors.

candidates.description: Variants that fit, most specific first.

equip_id.description:
The most specific variant, or the deepest common ancestor when the
evidence points at more than one; `None` when nothing matched.

rejected.description: Variants a rule matched but another of its rules contradicted.

Retrieved.description: A retrieved chunk as `ask --json` reports it.

ReviewItem.description: A lesson in the review queue, with every version.

needs_reviewer.description:
Two units edited it within the clock-skew bound: approving it needs
the reviewer to choose a version.

reopened.description: True when a newer version arrived after a review.

suggested_note.description:
The field note an unedited approval of `current` publishes, and
where it shows (the app shows these; it does not word its own).

Role.description: What a person may do at the hub.

asset.description: The specific machine (unit number, serial), as the user entered it.

RunReport.description: A run as it is exported and uploaded (`harvest-run/1`).

steps_known.description:
True when the steps come from the pack (texts, sections, every step
listed); false when the procedure changed and only the records are
known.

title.description: The procedure's title, when the pack was at hand.

asset.description: The unit (an asset id or what the technician typed).

role.description: The level (or role) the task is done at.

Scope.description: Limit a question or a search to part of the manual.

readings.description: Query words the pack does not hold as typed, and what they were read as.

boxes.description:
Where the passage sits on its page image, normalized 0 to 1 (a
passage may take more than one box).

SectionView.description: One section of the manual, ready to show.

Segment.description: One segment of an answer or lesson body.

oneOf.description: Plain prose. A claim: it must be supported in its paragraph.
A verbatim substring of the section's text.
A citation of a section.
A pack diagram.

A self-check in a lesson: the reader answers `question`, then sees
`answer`. It recalls what the lesson's cited paragraphs taught; it is
not a claim and supports nothing (CONTRACT "Answer-segment JSON").

SignalDecode.description: Decoded data and what it matches in the pack.

SignalDecodeParams.description: Raw vehicle data to decode into observations.

input.description: The text: log lines, frames, hex messages, or the typed code.

signal_kind.description: For a display code: its signal kind (`pump40.code`); any kind when absent.

SignalHit.description: One signal rule an observation matched.

citation.description: The rule's section citation, when it cites one.

has_tree.description: False when the rule leads to no troubleshooting tree.

section.description:
The cited section's verbatim text. For a rule with no tree this is
all the manual says (a cause with no corrective action).

SignalKind.description:
A kind of machine signal the pack maps (`pack_meta.signal_kinds`, else
derived from the signal map with the kind as its label).

example.description: A value as it would be typed or read (`spn:110/fmi:0`, `E21`).

ambiguous.description:
True when the hits lead to more than one tree (rules with no tree
do not count).

closest.description:
For each unmatched text observation, the closest entries in the
manual: never a match, never a start. The app says "no exact
entry; closest entries in this manual".

hits.description: Most specific first: exact, glob, prefix, regex; then observation order.

SignalRule.description: A machine signal pattern and the entry point it leads to.

pattern.description:
Exact (case and spacing folded), or `prefix:…`, `glob:…` (`*`, `?`),
`re:…` (a regular expression).

tree_id.description:
The tree it leads into; `None` when the manual prints a cause with
no troubleshooting (then `section_id` is what it says).

SignalSection.description: The manual text a signal rule cites.

unknown.description:
Valid-looking frames of messages this decoder does not know (their
CRC cannot be checked without the message's CRC_EXTRA).

StepOutcome.description: What recording a step returns: the guidance to show when it failed.

guidance.description:
The pack's guidance for a failed step. `quote_verified` says whether
its quote is verbatim in the cited section (a bake bug otherwise; the
app then shows the citation without the quote).

StepView.description:
The step view: the manual's content at the current node, the path so
far, and field knowledge kept apart from the manual.

field_notes.description:
Reviewer-approved field notes for this context. Field knowledge,
never the manual's text.

guards.description: Warnings, cautions and notes guarding this node, manual order.

possible_open.description:
The candidate causes still open at this point (the node's `possible`
facet, else the nearest one earlier on the path).

reference.description: The printed cross-reference, verbatim, when the node has one.

setup.description: The tree's initial setup (conditions, tools, references, personnel).

target.description:
Where this node leads in the pack; `None` when it names nothing the
pack holds (then `reference` is the manual's printed reference, to
show as "see … in the manual").

terminal.description: True when no branch leaves this node (the path ends here).

Support.description:
How the deterministic answer gate saw the question: enough to replay the
decision offline for any threshold. A section is kept when its coverage
reaches `threshold` and is within `window` of the best; the first
`max_sections` kept are composed; none kept means decline.

cache_similarity.description: Best answer-cache similarity, and the threshold a hit needs.

candidates.description: Retrieved sections in retrieval order, with their coverage.

concepts.description: The question's content concepts (stems), in order.

depth.description:
How many retrieved chunks the gate looked at: `candidates` and
`top_dense` come from these (`retrieved` lists the first `k`).

min_dense.description: The dense floor applied, when the dense gate was in force.

score.description: Best coverage over the candidates (the value the gate compares).

top_dense.description: Best dense cosine among the `depth` chunks (0 without dense).

coverage.description:
Share of `concepts` the section (with its retrieved chunks and the
role's explanation) covers.

rank.description: 1-based rank of its first retrieved chunk.

retrieval.description: Best fused retrieval score among its chunks.

Symptom.description: A symptom a technician reports, the way into a tree.

coverage.description: Share of the query's meaningful words the best phrase covers.

lexical.description:
The confidence rule's inputs, for calibrating it offline: the
lexical Dice of the best phrase, the meaningful query words it
covers and how many the query has, and the dense cosine (whenever
dense ran, counted or not).

margin.description:
This hit's score minus the best other hit's (its own score when it
is alone, which satisfies any margin).

confidence.description: The best hit's confidence; `none` with no hit.

dense.description: True when the dense half ran.

equip_id.description: The variant the search was filtered to.

signals.description: The signal match, when observations were given.

thresholds.description:
Every value of the ranking and confidence rule this search applied
(the pack's, with the call's overrides) and whether dense was
active: with each hit's inputs, the result can be replayed.

asset_id.description: The asset (its variant when `equip_id` is absent).

ranking.description: Overrides of the pack's ranking rule (for calibration).

SyncAttachmentsParams.description:
One pass of the attachment lane (after `sync.flush`; it sends nothing
while records are queued).

max_seconds.description:
Stop starting chunks after this long (default 10, at most 300). The
pass holds the records store, so a host calls it in short passes
while the link is up.

force.description:
Try now even while backing off after a refusal (an operator retrying
after the device was enrolled).

pack_errors.description: A pack the hub offered that could not be installed, and why.

attachments.description: The attachment lane, apart from the records.

failing.description: Pending items that have failed at least once.

last_synced_at.description: When an item was last acknowledged.

quarantined.description: Items whose stored payload no longer matches its hash; never sent.

battery_voltage.description: Volts; `None` when the autopilot does not know.

unhealthy.description: Present and enabled but not healthy.

Target.description: Where a `goto` (or an `action` that is a task) leads.

oneOf.description:
Another tree, at its entry or at `node_id` ("go to Table 3-2,
step 4").

TargetView.description: Where a `goto` or task action leads.

TaskStep.description: One step of a task or test procedure.

applies_to.description:
Equipment the step is limited to (empty: all), and whether it
applies to the equipment asked about.

guards.description: Shown before the step, in manual order, at every level.

Guards on the task (its section or above), shown once at its head;
a step carries only the guards on that step.

TestProcedure.description: The test procedure that answers a node's question.

expanded.description: Whether it opens expanded at this level.

guards.description: Guards on the whole procedure, shown once before its steps.

Tree.description: A whole tree, checked: every node passed and its text is verbatim.

TreeSummary.description: The tree a node belongs to.

oneOf.description: Query words found in the symptom's title or one of its synonyms.
An observation matched a signal rule for the symptom's tree.
Embedding similarity (only with the pack's embedder).

description: One JSON API over harvest-core: call(method, params) -> result. Generated; do not edit.
